(internal — dispatches MQTT pulse
always, plus EQLink/Modbus
start command per machine protocol)

span.p:
Modbus (CommProtocol.MODBUS) is currently write-only:
startMachine() is invoked from startCycle() to drive
IDLE -> RUNNING. readWasherStatus(), forcedStop() and
resetAlarm() exist in ModbusClient but are not yet
wired up to update machine status — Modbus machines
rely on MQTT telemetry for all other transitions.
